configurations.name: client-dev
configurations.comment: Attaches to the Vite dev server already running in the money_flow-client-1 container (docker compose up). No command on purpose: a second Vite would collide with the container's published 5173, and bare `vite` ignores PORT so autoPort cannot reassign it. Uses localhost rather than https://app.local.namelessnotion.com because the preview pane blocks that host's module scripts; note that GraphQL calls fail CORS from this origin (see README).
